scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_SELECT_SRC
(
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_SELECT_SRC
(
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                cc.CARDNUMBER,
                cc.EMBOSSNAME,
                cc.ACCOUNTID,
                cc.CARDTYPE,
                cc.CARDSUBTYPE,
                cc.CARDSTATUS,
                cc.EXPIRYDATE,
                cc.CUSTOMFIELD1,
                cc.CUSTOMFIELD2,
                cc.CUSTOMFIELD3,
                cc.CUSTOMFIELD4,
                cc.CUSTOMFIELD5,
                cc.BANK_ID,
                cc.CIFID,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS] B ON
            CC.CIFID = B.CIFID
            AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            AND CC.CARDNUMBER = B.CARDNUMBER
            AND CC.ACCOUNTID = B.ACCOUNTID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_GROUP_SRC
(
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = dateadd(dd,-1,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE))  FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS];


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CIFID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CIFID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CARDNUMBER,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CARDNUMBER,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ACCOUNTID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACCOUNTID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS
(
                CARDNUMBER,
                EMBOSSNAME,
                ACCOUNTID,
                CARDTYPE,
                CARDSUBTYPE,
                CARDSTATUS,
                EXPIRYDATE,
                CUSTOMFIELD1,
                CUSTOMFIELD2,
                CUSTOMFIELD3,
                CUSTOMFIELD4,
                CUSTOMFIELD5,
                BANK_ID,
                CIFID,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.CARDNUMBER,
                SRC.EMBOSSNAME,
                SRC.ACCOUNTID,
                SRC.CARDTYPE,
                SRC.CARDSUBTYPE,
                SRC.CARDSTATUS,
                SRC.EXPIRYDATE,
                SRC.CUSTOMFIELD1,
                SRC.CUSTOMFIELD2,
                SRC.CUSTOMFIELD3,
                SRC.CUSTOMFIELD4,
                SRC.CUSTOMFIELD5,
                SRC.BANK_ID,
                SRC.CIFID,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'CRM',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CBCCUSTCARDDETAILS_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
